_notes: Copy voice presets. Templates fill {slots} from content. Anything here that states a fact must map to a content field; adjectives are tone only. A human may override any string per build with --copy key=value or content.copy_overrides. Stage 2A (2026-10-20): a value may be a list of candidates; build.py uses the first whose {slots} all resolve to non-null content values, and fails the build if a {slot} survives. Voices with _meta.strict_facts carry no digits or number words outside {slots} (lib/schema.validate_voices enforces it). cta_sets: three CTA wording sets, rotated by build.py (index = registered sites using this voice, mod 3).
